analysis.title: Europe's recent relative strength: can it continue?
key_insights: Since the US AI trade peaked on 6 Oct 2026, the Nasdaq 100 has fallen 10.5% into correction territory, while the S&P 500 fell only 3.3% as rotation went to value and equal-weight stocks.
Over the same period the STOXX Europe 600 gained 4.3%, repeatedly reaching record highs, and outperformed the Nasdaq 100 by nearly 15 percentage points.

Nasdaq 100 failed to break the 28,750-28,900 resistance area after stabilising above its 2025 all-time high at 26,182. Downside pressure may persist while below that area, and a move toward 26,182 support cannot be ruled out.

Bloomberg Magnificent 7 Index (BM7P) rebounded from 32,600 support but failed at the 34,750-35,000 resistance zone, which coincides with the 50% Fibonacci retracement and the 50-day SMA. A break below 32,600 would bring 29,500 into focus. A break above 35,000 points to 36,000 and the 36,950 all-time high.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) fell below its 200-day SMA for the first time since March 2025. It failed at 10,660 (38.2% Fibonacci) and the 10,900 200-day SMA, and the next support area is 8,400-8,500.

Nvidia remains in a long-term upward sequence but is nearing a confluence zone: the 38.2%-50% Fibonacci retracement and the 200-week SMA, which has been support several times since 2013. Pictet says this suggests a potential cyclical low, but confirmation is needed. A decisive break below the 200-week SMA could bring consolidation toward 90.

The S&P 500/STOXX Europe 600 ratio has fallen from 14.86 resistance toward 13.90 support. A break lower would put the 12.50-12.90 area in focus, and a weekly close below 13.90 would be consistent with further tactical European outperformance.

The STOXX Europe 600 has stabilised near its rising 200-day SMA around 629. A weekly close above the RSI resistance that has held since the start of the year could bring medium-term upside toward 745 into focus.
European leadership since 6 Oct has come from defensives: Health Care +17%, Food & Beverages +17%, Retail +14%. Basic Resources -9%, Technology -6% and Banks -3% lagged.

Sectors representing 49.15% of STOXX 600 market cap are outperforming the benchmark. Banks and Industrial Goods, together 29% of market cap, have not yet participated, so a catch-up there could extend the rally.

Sector targets: Health Care (SXDP) approaching its 2024 all-time high at 1,287, with 1,390 above it. Retail (SXRP) at a new all-time high of 531, target 585. Food & Beverages (SX3P) broke a downtrend in place since 2021, targets 755-775 then 820. Insurance (SXIP) broke a trading range, target 610.
Industrial Goods and Services (SXNP) broke falling resistance in place since August. A break above 1,165 could open 1,205, then the medium-term target area of 1,265-1,290.

Seasonality since ChatGPT's launch in Nov 2022: November-February cumulative return averaged 12.30% for the STOXX Europe 600 against 7.25% for the S&P 500. Europe led in December, January and February, while the S&P 500's best average month was November (+5.04% vs +3.90% for STOXX 600).

market_movers.rationale: Technical confluence of the 38.2%-50% Fibonacci retracement and the 200-week SMA may mark a cyclical low ahead of Q3 results this week, but confirmation is needed. A decisive break below the 200-week SMA could bring consolidation toward 90.

sector_views.rationale: Up 17% since 6 Oct and approaching the 2024 all-time high at 1,287, with 1,390 the next level on a break.
Reached a new all-time high of 531, above its Nov 2021 high, with 585 in focus.
Broke a bearish trend in place since 2021, with initial targets of 755-775 and then 820.
Broke above a trading range, with 610 in focus.
Lagging, but initial positive technical signals after breaking falling resistance. A break above 1,165 could open 1,205 and 1,265-1,290.
Down 3% since 6 Oct and lagging as a heavyweight sector. A catch-up could support further European gains.
Nasdaq 100, BM7P and SOX are all below key resistance or moving averages, and downside pressure may persist.

earnings_insights: Nvidia reports Q3 results the week of 17 Nov 2026. The report gives no EPS or revenue figures. Pictet notes earnings and related announcements may add to near-term volatility.
risk_factors: US tech could extend its decline toward 26,182 on the Nasdaq 100, 32,600 then 29,500 on BM7P, and 8,400-8,500 on SOX.
Nvidia faces leadership uncertainty and a volatility scandal ahead of Q3 results, which may add near-term volatility.
The European rally has so far been led by defensives, and Banks and Industrials, together 29% of the index, have yet to confirm it.
A weekly close above 13.90 on the S&P 500/STOXX 600 ratio, with a recovery toward 14.86, would reverse the European outperformance.
vol_and_positioning: The Nasdaq 100 is in correction territory, down 10.5% from its 6 Oct 2026 high.
Rotation toward value and equal-weight stocks limited the S&P 500 pullback to 3.3%.
The S&P 500/STOXX Europe 600 ratio has fallen from 14.86 toward support at 13.90.

tension_points.bull_case: Europe is above its rising 200-day SMA near 629 and approaching 745. The S&P 500/STOXX 600 ratio is testing 13.90 support. Banks and Industrials, 29% of the index, have not yet joined the rally. Seasonality since Nov 2022 favours Europe from year-end into Q1.
tension_points.bear_case: The rally has been led by defensive sectors, and Banks and Industrials still lag. The ratio could instead hold 13.90 and rebound toward 14.86.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A hold of the S&P 500/STOXX 600 ratio at 13.90 support, instead of a weekly close below it, would undercut the scenario of further European outperformance.

tension_points.bull_case: Nvidia is nearing a confluence zone, the 200-week SMA and 38.2%-50% Fibonacci retracement, which may mark a cyclical low. BM7P has been stabilising above 32,600.
tension_points.bear_case: Nasdaq 100 failed at 28,750-28,900, BM7P failed at 34,750-35,000, and SOX fell below its 200-day SMA and failed at 10,660 and 10,900.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A break above 35,000 on BM7P would point to a recovery toward 36,000, undercutting the bear case.
